text:
emily: Heads-up: saw a 10m wave of evictions in us-east1 this morning around 03:12 UTC. Tiny GPU workloads got bounced, some retries failed.

nate: I pulled the scheduler profile. It's a binpack ripple: when two AZs had short provisioning lag, scheduler started moving fractional-gang pods across AZs to fill slots, triggering taints->evict cycles.

hiro: Data: 42 evictions in 9m, 7 reschedule failures. Warmpool depth was 0 in us-east1-b due to recent scale-down.

ops-bot: [alert] evictions.medium(us-east1) 7900012345 - 42 evictions in 9m, resched-fail 7

emily: Short-term: pause fractional-gang for namespace gpu-tiny, raise warmpool min by +2 in affected AZs, and set scheduler flag --avoid-cross-az-fractional=true (canary).

nate: Command to patch workload-class (rollbackable):
```bash
kubectl -n infra patch config workloads-gpu --type merge -p '{"data":{"gpu-tiny.allowFractional":"false"}}'
```

hiro: Also recommend a label-quiesce: when node labels change, mark node as "label-quiesce=true" for 120s so scheduler avoids aggressive preempts.

emily: Agree. Medium-term: change warmpool autoscaler to maintain cross-AZ cushion for tiny-GPU requests and add "label-quiesce" to relabeler flow. Also add metric "fractional-move-rate" and alert at 5/min.

ops-bot: [note] actions scheduled: canary patch apply in us-east1-a at 7900012360 by emily

nate: Canary applied; monitoring queue depth and eviction rate. If stable, roll to full region.

emily: Quick cost hit estimate for the event: ~1.8 GPU-hours wasted, ~8% delta for the hour. Filing follow-up ticket ENG-PLAT-4810 with mitigation steps.

hiro: I'll add runbook snippet: "If evictions spike after relabel/scale events: 1) pause relabeler 2) increase warmpool 3) disable fractional-gang for tiny namespace 4) set label-quiesce for 2m"

emily: Thanks. Will update when rollout completes.
